title: rforest genus-3 audit and completion design
objective: Audit the newly MIT-licensed rforest implementation and papers, prove the exact genus-3 coefficient candidate/completion requirements, test standalone portability on available hosts, and deliver an implementation-ready decision with fixtures and benchmarks

handoff.summary: Pins canonical MIT rforest commit 3103d396c67cb1685131b1f11e84975cca335bdf and delivers an implementation-ready source/license/ABI/platform audit, a portable native trace harness, a 101-record Sage/Magma genus-3 oracle, and an exact BigInt real-Weil residue-lifting specification. The audit proves c1 uniqueness for p>144, exact-order uniqueness for p>=1601, the need for twist disambiguation below that threshold, and a Las Vegas Jacobian certification strategy with explicit sampling and operation bounds. Upstream source builds produced the identical trace fixture on Linux x86-64, Linux arm64, macOS arm64, and native Windows x64 after the documented LLP64 clzll correction.
risks: rforest is only the generic remainder-forest matrix-product engine; the Harvey--Sutherland curve transition matrices, admissible-prime handling, row transformations, and reconstruction remain a separate implementation lane.

The full 21-translation-unit bundled zz link closure uses GMP internals, requires 64-bit limbs, and has process-global FFT/memory state, so the private adapter must validate inputs, hide the ABI, and serialize calls.

Old smalljac genus-3 completion is useful as an algorithm design but cannot be linked as shipped because genus-3 compose/square definitions and the p-adic producer are absent; Sage.js must certify candidates using its verified Jacobian law.

The exact-order p>=1601 result is a completion theorem, not a cheap way to obtain the order; practical performance still depends on the congruence-strided O(p^(1/4)) Jacobian search and a twist/fallback path.

The standalone portable C harness is intentionally unclassified in the shared native-code inventory because this audit lane did not claim that registry; the integration lane must classify it before the branch is merged.

The coordinator stopped the duplicate full pnpm test:native run because concurrent project builds saturated the host. The focused 101-record exact checker and four-platform upstream source smoke builds passed; repository-wide native validation remains an integration receipt.
next_steps: Distribution lane: classify the portable harness, vendor the pinned 21-source rforest closure with LICENSE/COPYING, apply the fixed-width clang-cl patch, and expose only a private packed Hasse--Witt residue boundary.
Transition lane: implement and differentially test the Harvey--Sutherland curve-to-matrix and output-normalization layer against the ordinary Hasse--Witt fallback and the committed oracle.
Jacobian lane: implement exact candidate enumeration first, then the O(p^(1/4)) primary/twist certificate search; stop only on uniqueness and otherwise fall back.
Integration lane: retain the portable trace fixture in Linux x86-64/arm64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64 CI and serialize all rforest calls until upstream state is made contextual.
